name: A column-generation-based matheuristic for periodic and symmetric train timetabling with integrated passenger routing
description: Mined from A column-generation-based matheuristic for periodic and symmetric train timetabling with integrated passenger routing (European Journal of Operational Research, 2021).

indices.name: Q

indices.description: Set of nodes in passenger routing graph.

indices.description: Set of arcs in passenger routing graph.

indices.name: delta_minus

indices.name: delta_plus

parameters.description: Cost of choosing a group of line paths q.

variables.name: f
variables.description: Flow on arc a for commodity k.

variables.name: x
variables.description: Binary variable indicating if timetabling arc a is used.

variables.name: z
variables.description: Passenger travel time for commodity k.

variables.name: lambda
variables.description: Binary variable indicating whether line group path q is selected.

variables.name: pi_1
variables.description: Dual variable associated with commodity k in Benders optimality cut.

variables.description: Dual variable associated with commodity k in Benders optimality cut.

constraints.description: Minimum headway between consecutive arrivals at each station for each direction.
